dismiss.rememberHelp: If enabled, the published site remembers this visitor already dismissed it (localStorage) and won't show it again on future visits. Useful for cookie notices or promo banners.

tabs.noProps: This component has no editable properties.

iconPressed.help: Shown when the node is in its active state (`toggle` behavior). Empty = no change.

pageVisibilityList.empty: The site has no pages yet.

behaviors.title: Animations & effects
behaviors.empty: No animations or effects. Add one to enable interactivity (requires JS on the published site).
behaviors.hint: Add animations and interactive effects to this element.
behaviors.notAvailable: This element does not support animations or effects.

desc.carousel: Turns children into a swipeable carousel (requires JS).
desc.reveal-on-scroll: Animates the element into view as it enters the screen.
desc.theme-toggle: Button to switch between light and dark theme.
desc.form-validation: Validates fields in real time with error messages (requires JS).
desc.sticky: Sticks the element while scrolling; adds a visual marker once the page has scrolled.
desc.count-up: Animates the number from 0 to its final value as it enters the screen.
desc.marquee: Scrolls the logos in a continuous loop (requires JS to pause on hover).
desc.expandable: Collapses the block to a set height and adds a "Show more" button (fully visible without JS).
desc.parallax: Moves the background at a different speed than the rest of the page while scrolling.
desc.scroll-progress: Shows a bar that advances with the page's reading progress.
desc.scroll-spy: Highlights the visible section's link in an anchor menu within the same page.
desc.lightbox: Clicking the image opens it full-screen, with navigation between several (requires JS).

sticky.scrolledThresholdHelp: Amount of scroll in pixels after which the element changes appearance (for example, gaining a shadow or becoming more compact) to signal that the page has scrolled.

parallax.fallbackHelp: This effect doesn't show in some older browsers. With this option on, it still shows there using an alternative method; if you turn it off, the effect simply won't show in those cases — but the page content always displays and works normally.

scroll-progress.fallbackHelp: This bar doesn't advance in some older browsers. With this option on, it still advances there using an alternative method; if you turn it off, the bar simply won't advance in those cases — but the page content always displays and works normally.

scroll-spy.rootMarginHelp: Defines which band of the screen decides which section counts as "active". By default, the top 20% and bottom 60% of the screen are ignored, leaving a narrow band near the top: whichever section passes through it gets highlighted in the menu.

lightbox.durationHelp: Duration in milliseconds of the full-screen overlay's open/close animation. Ignored if the visitor has the system's reduced-motion preference turned on.

themeToggle.noThemes: The site has no themes to switch between yet.
themeToggle.storageKeyHelp: Name the published site uses to remember the theme each visitor chose and reapply it on their next visit (it takes priority over the system theme, and is stored in the browser via localStorage). Change it only if you need this toggle to remember its preference separately from another one on the same domain. Default: “pb-theme”.
